S32.31.needs: a Free account or a paid account, and a chat with an HTML artifact
S32.31.note: The quoted line 745 and WebChatPage line 5834 no longer contain the feature; the "Download as HTML" item is at ArtifactPreview.tsx line 2388 and only appears when the artifact has more than one download option, which HTML artifacts do.
steps: Sign in and open a chat that has an HTML artifact (ask AGI to make a web page if none exists).
Open the artifacts panel from the "Artifacts" button and select the artifact so its preview opens.
Click the download button (tooltip "Download", aria-label "Download artifact") in the preview header.
Click "Download as HTML" in the menu.
Open the downloaded file in a browser and compare it with Expected: a standalone HTML file of the design.
S32.31.where: Open an artifact in the artifacts panel (title "Artifacts") > Download artifact (title "Download") > Download as HTML

S32.33.needs: a Free account or a paid account, and a chat with two or more artifacts
S32.33.note: Image export is a separate control in the preview header (ArtifactPreview.tsx line 3466, aria-label "Download image") and the ArtifactsPanel.tsx line 745 and downloadArtifacts.ts line 108 cover the zip; the quoted WebChatPage line 5834 no longer contains the feature.
steps: Sign in and open a chat that has two or more artifacts.
Open the artifacts panel from the "Artifacts" button.
Click "Download all" in the panel header (the button only shows when the panel holds more than one artifact).
Wait for the toast "Artifact download ready" and open the zip file from Downloads.
Compare with Expected: the zip holds the artifacts as files. For an image artifact, open its preview and click the header button with aria-label "Download image" to export the image instead.
S32.33.where: Artifacts panel (title "Artifacts") > Download all (aria-label "Download all artifacts as zip")

S32.34.needs: a Free account or a paid account, and an artifact with at least two versions
S32.34.note: "Show changes" is hidden for PDF, DOCX and image artifacts and needs a previous version; "Restore version" appears only when the shown version is not the latest; the version history list also has a "Restore" button per version (aria-label "Restore version N", ArtifactVersionHistory.tsx line 171).
steps: Sign in and open an artifact that has been edited at least once (two or more versions).
Click "Previous version" in the preview header to show an earlier version.
Click "More artifact actions" and choose "Show changes" to compare it with the version before it; check the summary line and the highlighted text.
To restore, click "More artifact actions" and choose "Restore version N", then click "Restore" in the dialog "Restore version N?".
Compare with Expected: the earlier version is shown again as the newest version, and the version counter increases.
S32.34.where: Open an artifact with more than one version > Previous version (aria-label "Previous version") or the version counter "Version N of M" (Version history) > More artifact actions > Show changes or Restore version
